env.name: ADB_MYSQL_HOST
env.description: AnalyticDB for MySQL host address (direct-connection mode). Not required when using temporary-account mode (Alibaba Cloud AK/SK only, with region_id/db_cluster_id passed per tool call).

env.description: AnalyticDB for MySQL port number (direct-connection mode). Not required when using temporary-account mode (Alibaba Cloud AK/SK only, with region_id/db_cluster_id passed per tool call).

env.description: Database user for authentication (direct-connection mode). Not required when using temporary-account mode (Alibaba Cloud AK/SK only, with region_id/db_cluster_id passed per tool call).

env.description: Database password for authentication (direct-connection mode). Not required when using temporary-account mode (Alibaba Cloud AK/SK only, with region_id/db_cluster_id passed per tool call).

env.name: ADB_MYSQL_DATABASE
env.description: Database name to connect to (optional; can be passed per-call via the database tool argument instead)

env.name: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Alibaba Cloud access key ID; required to enable the OpenAPI tool group (cluster management, diagnostics, monitoring) and/or temporary-account database mode. MCP_TOOLSETS must also include "openapi" to expose the OpenAPI tools even when this is set.

env.name: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
env.description: Alibaba Cloud access key secret; required to enable the OpenAPI tool group (cluster management, diagnostics, monitoring) and/or temporary-account database mode. MCP_TOOLSETS must also include "openapi" to expose the OpenAPI tools even when this is set.

env.name: MCP_TOOLSETS
env.description: Comma-separated tool groups to enable: "sql", "openapi", or the shortcut "all" (openapi,sql). Only controls tool-group exposure; the openapi group is also auto-disabled if Alibaba Cloud AK/SK are not configured. Default is "sql" only.

env.name: ENABLE_SQL_WRITE_TOOLS
env.description: Set to "true" to let execute_sql run unrestricted SQL (DDL/DML/DCL/TCL, no statement-type validation). Default is read-only mode (SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN only). Enable only for trusted clients with a least-privilege database account.

servers.name: uyuni
servers.title: Uyuni
servers.description: Manage Linux infrastructure through the Uyuni systems management platform via MCP

env.name: UYUNI_SERVER
env.description: Uyuni server address and port

env.name: UYUNI_USER
env.description: Username for Uyuni authentication

env.name: UYUNI_PASS
env.description: Password for Uyuni authentication

env.name: UYUNI_AUTH_SERVER
env.description: OAuth 2.0 authorization server URL

env.name: UYUNI_MCP_SSL_VERIFY
env.description: Enable SSL certificate verification (default: true)

env.name: UYUNI_MCP_WRITE_TOOLS_ENABLED
env.description: Enable write tools for state-changing operations (default: false)

env.name: UYUNI_SSH_PRIV_KEY
env.description: SSH private key used by the add_system tool to bootstrap new systems into Uyuni

env.name: UYUNI_SSH_PRIV_KEY_PASS
env.description: Passphrase for UYUNI_SSH_PRIV_KEY when the key is encrypted
